subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should main-session restart recovery retain accepted attempts cumulatively until successful progress, even when gateway restarts are separated by long supervisor backoff intervals?
rationale: This is intentionally broader than the subagent rapid re-wedge policy and changes when an existing session permanently stops receiving automatic recovery; tests can prove mechanics but cannot choose that operator-facing contract.
